caption: The drawing depicts a grandfather clock illustrated in black ink on a light-colored, likely off-white, background. The clock is shown in two views: a frontal view on the left and a side profile on the right. The frontal view reveals ornate details such as a decorative pediment with two scroll-like shapes on either side, a central finial, and a circular clock face marked with Roman numerals and two clock hands. The central section of the clock's body features vertical wood grain lines, while the base section displays a different pattern of wood grain. The clock stands on four short bracket feet. The side profile view on the right mirrors the proportions and wood grain details seen in the front view, with the finial visible on top. The entire composition is contained within a single-lined rectangular border. At the bottom right corner of the drawing, the name "Ernest Towers Jr." is written.
title: Grandfather Clock
